gaps.detail: No legal timber harvesting landbase boundary is used. Tenure is a rights footprint, not a harvest-landbase determination.
gaps.effect: All areas are screening proxies and must not be labelled THLB or AAC.

gaps.detail: No national DEM is present in the workspace, so no slope, elevation, operability, or site-degradation filter is applied.
gaps.effect: Steep and inoperable terrain remains in every v2 area.

gaps.detail: The NBAC bundle is the 2020 annual vintage (YEAR=2020 for all 710 polygons). It contains no 2010 or 2015 fire history, so those sensitivity screens cannot be computed from this input.
gaps.effect: Only a 2020 fire screen is reported; the 2010 and 2015 cases are explicit gaps, not zero-disturbance assumptions.

gaps.detail: NBAC polygons are annual fire perimeters with YEAR/NFIREID and polygon attributes. They are not a cumulative severity or burn-class stack, so no cumulative class is interpreted.
gaps.effect: The disturbance screen is an annual 2020 burned/not-burned mask.

gaps.detail: All 13 NRN province bundles were materialised and used. NRN is the public road network; resource, industrial, winter, and decommissioned roads are not represented, and road condition/seasonality is absent.
gaps.effect: Road distance is an optimistic public-road access proxy.

gaps.detail: SCANFI median age is a stand-age prediction. Excluding stands below 20 or 30 years assumes they are not merchantable at the screen date, which is stricter than the v1 height/biomass/closure thresholds and ignores partial harvest, thinning, and regeneration delay.
gaps.effect: Age screens reduce area beyond merchantability alone.

gaps.detail: The v1 managed share is uniform inside each province-ecoprovince. Tenure was not re-intersected with the age, burn, or road rasters.
gaps.effect: Spatial tenure pattern is not represented.

gaps.detail: SCANFI age is a 30 m prediction surface, not a provincial inventory or a time-since-disturbance record.
gaps.effect: Age thresholds are screening conventions, not statutory rules.

limitations: No legal THLB boundary is used. Tenure is a rights footprint, not a harvest-landbase determination.
No national slope or elevation DEM is available, so no slope, steep-terrain, or site-degradation screen is applied.
The road screen is a 990 m public-NRN Euclidean distance proxy, not a spatial road overlay; resource, industrial, winter, and decommissioned roads are absent.
NBAC 2020 is the only annual fire vintage available; 2010 and 2015 disturbance cases are gaps, not zero-disturbance cases.
SCANFI age is a prediction surface; the age >= 30 screen is a screening convention, not a legal rule.
The mask is an area-share proxy. Selected blocks are not spatially intersected with the tenure, burn, road, or slope rasters, and do not claim legal THLB or slope screening.
The v1 managed share is uniform inside each province-ecoprovince; spatial tenure pattern is not represented.
NU and PE have no accepted 2016 tenure coverage; their operable area is intentionally blank, not zero, and no block is selected there.
operable_screen.selection_rule: Within each province, sort blocks by a stable blake2b hash of province:block_id (tie-break block_id) and take whole blocks until the cumulative selected forest area reaches operable_share_of_treed * WS4 province forest area.
operable_screen.target_rule: share-based: published operable_share_of_treed applied to the WS4 990 m block forest area; the published absolute operable area is reported separately and is not forced onto a different denominator
